en.sayyid-mohsen-al-husayni-al-milani: 2. My father narrated to me from Sa’d, from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad ibn ‘Isā, from Mūsā ibn Faďl, from ‘Ali ibn Ḥakam, from someone who narrated to him, from Ḥanān ibn Sadīr, who said:

I asked Abā ‘Abdillāh (Imam Sādiq (a.s.)), “What do you say about going to the Ziyārah of the grave of Ḥusain (a.s.)?” Imam (a.s.) replied: Go to his Ziyārah and do not neglect him, for verily he is the Master of the Martyrs and he is the Master of the Youth of Paradise. Yaḥyā ibn Zakariyyā (a.s.) is similar to Ḥusain (a.s.) and the heavens and the earth wept (only) over the two of them.
